chunks.parent_title: KIP-5: Next generation consumer group protocol
chunks.text:
# Motivation

The classic protocol makes clients do assignment, which causes long rebalances.

# Proposed Changes

Move assignment to the group coordinator. Consumers send heartbeats; the coordinator computes assignments.

# Rejected Alternatives

Keeping client-side assignment with incremental cooperative rebalancing was rejected because it does not fix coordinator-side fencing.

# Section 4: Fencing

Members with stale epochs are fenced and must rejoin.

Tracked in KAFKA-100.
